IDQ20855
Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology

Initial Minor Flood Warning for the Bulloo River

Issued at 9:39 am AEST on Wednesday 21 October 2026
Flood Warning Number: 1


MINOR FLOODING LIKELY AT QUILPIE FROM WEDNESDAY EVENING

Rainfall during the last few days across the upper reaches of the Bulloo River catchment
has resulted in river level rises along the Bulloo River upstream of Quilpie. Minor
flooding is likely at Quilpie from Wednesday evening.

Bulloo River to Quilpie:
Minor flooding is likely along the Bulloo River at Quilpie

The Bulloo River at Quilpie is currently at 2.79 m and rising, below the minor flood
level. The Bulloo River at Quilpie is likely to exceed the minor flood level (3.00 m)
Wednesday evening. The river may reach around 3.40 m Thursday evening, with minor
flooding.

Safety Advice:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous.
* Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways.
* Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads.
* Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay
informed.
* For local emergency management warnings and advice visit
www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.

For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening
emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

Next issue:
The next warning will be issued by 01:00 PM AEST on Thursday 22 October 2026.

This advice is also available by dialling 1300 659 219. Warning, rainfall and river
information are available at http://www.bom.gov.au/australia/flood.
